quests.title: That Which Our Ancestors Entrusted

dialogue.t: A breeze from the south blew across Watatsumi Island today — a sure sign that friends would come visit.
Every time you say something like this, that means things are about to get busy... for us.
Oh, don't say that. Haven't we had a fruitful partnership? The most fruitful sort, in fact.
That said, I do have something to ask of the two of you today.
It is told in my family that apart from the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri, we also added a different set of trials. One unrelated to Watatsumi Island's survival, but instead, related to the truth.
Now that the island is no longer under existential threat, I would just like to tell you this. Consider it our clan's duty.
You can go to the place they call the Serpent's Heart. The clues to this second set of trials is hidden there.
...Well, that's a relief! Guess I can safely hand this crushing responsibility on to my future daughter now.
...Is that how you pay respect to your ancestral mission?
Paimon still doesn't get you even after all this time, Tsuyuko...

quests.description: Concerned about the progress of the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri, you decide to visit Sangonomiya Shrine…
